title: mail-server: test multipart Email create with subParts
description: JMAP-mits (ee3c9d48) made validate_body_part reject a non-multipart part with no partId, blobId or subParts. No test creates an Email whose bodyStructure is multipart with subParts and no partId/blobId, so a regression that rejected legitimate multipart creates would go unnoticed. Add that positive test (oracle: RFC 8621 §4.1.4).
